sections.content: The trust-recovery plan defines R0-R5 acceptance for a hash-bound coordinator lifecycle. It requires persisted run identity, successor reservation, controlled refresh rules, verified knowledge and LKG gates, legacy RED matching, read-only historical replay, and terminal completion bound to explicit candidate inputs.
sections.title: Acceptance requirements

sections.content: The migration bridge materializes declared RED-test templates for R0-R2 only. It validates invocation, writes only specified repository-relative test paths, reuses byte-identical files, rejects conflicts, and emits test paths with an empty capability list.
sections.title: Migration support

sections.content: The terminal validator binds candidate state, registered selectors, contracts, receipts, knowledge context, and lifecycle evidence. It rejects invalid paths, hashes, JSON, commands, slices, and lifecycle states. Full validation requires R0-R4 and emits a deterministic non-authorizing completion receipt; the helper derives validator and candidate identities.
sections.title: Validator behavior
